title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode3 For the Cheering Competition

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So I agreed to be their director for the cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa! That sounds really fun!
Just hearing you say, “Cheering competition,” is getting me super excited☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting both you and Tsukasa to join the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What?
Tsukasa also joined the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he sent a message saying...
<I won't be able to make our meeting in SEKAI as I've been chosen to become the vice captain of the red team's cheer squad.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why he isn't here today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does that mean you two are gonna be busy for a little while, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't actually join the cheer squad. I'm just there to help them... But I suppose I'm a de facto member since I'll be working with them hand in hand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, this is my first time hearing of Tsukasa joining the cheer squad. We're on the blue team, so we'll be facing each other as opponents.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean you and Tsukasa are gonna have a big showdown during the cheering competition?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No fair! I wanna cheer too...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's cheer them on together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As much as I want to, I have to help out with the gymnastics club at this really big tournament that day...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Emu, you're in the gymnastics club?!
That's so cool☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I go to lots of other clubs too!
I try to help out whenever someone really needs help!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's sad that I can't go to Kamiyama High's Sports Festival... So you guys are gonna need to cheer for the others in my place!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are gonna come watch?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Obviously!
We cheered during Emu's Sports Festival, so we've gotta do the same during your guys' Sports Festival☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hold on. If Tsukasa's on the red team, and Rui's on the blue team... Which team are you on, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm on the green team.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I had no idea.
That splits us up rather nicely.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Like the real “Three Kingdoms”.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Three Kingdoms”?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, we failed to mention that.
Our school's Sports Festival will be going with a “Three Kingdoms” theme this year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
That sounds like a tough theme.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I remember seeing that in one of the books you guys brought over! But it was a bit too much for me, so I couldn't finish it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What kind of story is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Simply put, it's about these three kingdoms that are vying for power with the leader of each fiercely battling against one another...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: During the cheering competition, I'm thinking about having someone from the actual story appear so that others who aren't as familiar with it can enjoy the show... A famous general, such as Liu Bei...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Liu Bei...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Liu-bei?
Do you know what they're talking about, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Liu-bi...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I know♪
It's the green thing Kappas like to eat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Apparently, they become very yummy after you let them cool for a while in a stream during summer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I believe you're thinking of the Japanese word for cucumber.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Haha. Oh, Luka☆
But you're right about them sounding alike.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, darn...
Then, what were you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A man who drew a massive following and established his own kingdom during a time of war and turmoil. This is so we can get our theme out in the open, so there's no need to be familiar with the actual story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I'm struggling to find a good order for all our ideas. I want to include as many of them as possible, but getting them to mesh properly is proving to be a challenge...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The captain spent a whole year coming up with them, right? As tough as this task sounds, aren't there any helpful hints we can give him...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Cucumbers... Kappa... Water...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem so at home in the water... Swimming together must be so much fun... Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Swimming... In the water...
I plan to include a part that involves jumping in a fire...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But we're on the blue team...
It might be good to include some motifs that reflect our team color.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Combine that with Liu Bei and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui, the speed at which you think and come up with ideas reminds me of Zhuge Liang.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so cool, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, Zhuge who...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You may want to go through that Three Kingdoms book again, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, this idea should do nicely.
I think I'll head home for the day to wrap it all up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, it's already that far along?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Way to go, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be far away during your Sports Festival, but I promise to cheer like crazy for all of you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You can do it, Rui!
You can do it, Tsukasa!
You can do it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, settle down...
The Sports Festival isn't for a good while.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's hard not to be encouraged by Emu's cheers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
Honestly, she's probably the best candidate for the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll have to do my best to encourage everyone the way Emu did with us just now.
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I'd like to go over some of the finer details while seeing how we all move together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The story itself will involve Liu Bei appearing in a land that's been impoverished by its corrupt government to give the downtrodden soldiers and citizens a chance to rise up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: With us as the soldiers and citizens.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes, having a general would mean my idea's still in play. The one that involves running around the campus while twirling a weapon around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. As our star, Captain, the way you carry yourself will take the highest priority. I'd like to work on your character's details more, but for now, feel free to do as you please...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Captain.
Mind unleashing some flashy moves to give everyone a morale boost?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Inspire us, Captain!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Leave it to me. I've been training for this day since running around with a weapon is the one thing I've absolutely been wanting to include.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Raaawwwrrr!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, cool!
This is awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each squad member will be given a role which suits them well, so let's keep going over details while seeing how we're doing as a group.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
Yeah...
This could be pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: I'm kinda worried since I've never done anything like this before, but you're right... This could be fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you think we're gonna be, Mizuki? I can't wait to find out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Still, I can't believe he came up with all of this in one day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nice job, Rui!
You're a directing genius!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, this still needs a few adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nonetheless, I'm starting to get a solid image in my head. At the same time, I feel like it needs an extra bit of spice...)
So you actually put your name in to be the captain despite what happened last time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: This must be our first time meeting, blue team members. Nice to meet you all. We're the red team's cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! How long's it been? The day before yesterday? I wasn't expecting to see you here like this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, you're on the cheer squad too?! Did you volunteer or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You think I'm here by choice...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tsukasa was so obnox...
No, adamant about me doing this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, he was reluctant at first, but he gladly accepted after I explained to him that we needed his help and that only he could fill this part for the red team's cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't “gladly” accept anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I'd heard that someone had joined the blue team's cheer squad to help out... But I didn't realize that person was you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
I was surprised to hear yesterday that you'd joined the cheer squad as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And based on their captain's demeanor...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I had a feeling that I'd be facing you again this year...

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Of course.
Don't you remember our motto?
“Where there is battle, there is us.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Captain, is this the “archrival” you were talking about?!
